All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
DataInstr
Represents a DATA instruction and stores the initial list of non-negative numbers.
FilterInstr
Represents a FILTER instruction, which keeps a comparison and an operand.
FilterInstr.Comparison
Supported comparison operators for the FILTER instruction.
Instruction
Common root of all MiniLang instructions.
IrGenerator
Serializes a validated instruction list into the IR text file format.
Lexer
Splits the source text into the token stream used by the parser.
LexicalException
Reports a lexical error and the source line where it occurred.
Main
Entry point of the Java stage of the MiniLang pipeline.
MapInstr
Represents a MAP instruction, which transforms each element using one operator.
MapInstr.Operator
Arithmetic operators supported by the MAP instruction.
MiniLangCompiler
Connects the lexical analysis, syntactic validation, semantic checks and IR generation.
Parser
Parses the token stream produced by the lexer and builds the instruction model.
PrintInstr
Represents the terminal PRINT instruction of the MiniLang program.
ReduceInstr
Represents a REDUCE instruction, which collapses an entire list into one value.
ReduceInstr.Aggregate
Reduction functions accepted by the language.
SemanticAnalyzer
Validates the semantic consistency of an already syntactically correct program.
SemanticException
Reports a semantic rule violation and the source line where it occurred.
SyntaxException
Reports a syntax error and the source line where it occurred.
Token
Lexical unit and its source line, numbered from 1.
TokenType
Token categories recognized by the MiniLang lexer.
